welcome.title: Gathernet
welcome.privacyNote: No email. No phone number. Your recovery phrase is your key.

create.nameHint: Your display name is only shown to people you connect with. You can change it anytime.
create.phraseWarning: Write these 12 words down on paper, in order. They are the only way to recover your account. Anyone who has them has your account — Gathernet cannot reset or recover them for you.
create.confirmError: That word doesn't match. Check your paper and try again.
create.unlockHint: This password protects your keys on this device only. It is not stored anywhere else and cannot be reset — if you forget it, restore with your recovery phrase.

restore.title: Restore your account
restore.hint: Enter your 12-word recovery phrase, separated by spaces.
restore.invalid: That's not a valid recovery phrase.
restore.notFound: No account found for this phrase.

unlock.title: Welcome back
unlock.forgetConfirm: This removes your keys and messages from this browser. You will need your recovery phrase to get back in. Continue?

friends.title: Friends
friends.empty: No friends yet. Invite someone you trust.
friends.blockConfirm: Block {{name}}? They won't be able to reconnect with you.

addFriend.title: Add a friend
addFriend.inviteHint: Share this code or QR with someone you trust. It works once and expires in 7 days.
addFriend.invalidCode: That code is invalid or was already used.
addFriend.scanHint: Point your camera at your friend's QR code.
addFriend.scanUnsupported: Camera scanning isn't supported in this browser — enter the code instead.

chat.cannotSend: Encryption is still being set up for this chat.

settings.title: Settings
settings.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? It will be signed out immediately and removed from your encrypted chats.
settings.addDevice: To add a device, open Gathernet there and choose “I have a recovery phrase”.

pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of Gathernet is available.
